text: I do not give trade instructions or sizes; that decision stays with Bernardo, and any size suggestion comes only from the sizing assistant in paper risk units. Facts: the LME copper spread net of interest is 2.037% backwardation, at the 98th percentile since 2014, and 1.73 pp above the 0.308% that visible stocks imply. Inference: the curve is tighter than stocks explain, a contemporaneous description rather than a forecast.
